## About
J D Auto Glass Miami Inc is an auto glass shop based in Hialeah. We handle windshield replacement and auto glass repair, and we can come to where your car is.
Customers tell us they notice the details: seals and trim put in properly, a windshield that fits right, and a car left clean when we're done. They also mention our fair prices and that we help with insurance claims.
We're rated 5 stars from 923 Google reviews, and we'd like to earn yours too.

## Services
- Windshield replacement: Full windshield replacement, done carefully so the new glass fits right.
- Auto glass repair: Repair for damaged glass when a full replacement isn't needed.
- We come to you: We can bring the work to where you are, so you don't have to come to us.

## FAQ
Q: Do you come to me?
A: Yes. We can come to you.

Q: Can you help with my insurance claim?
A: Yes. Customers tell us we handled their insurance claim and kept it easy and stress free.

Q: Are you open on Sunday?
A: No, we're closed on Sunday.
